rows.en: Most likely, that's the Gaia Gate.
Underground, huh... So there's even more below those ruins?
Then why don't we just hurry up and go check it out?
Exactly. All right, Accel and Birth, you two go with them and start the investigation.
The Gaia Gate... But what's that device?
That device is draining the Earth's memories out of it. By force...
So you crawled out again! You damn snake bastard!!
Garagaranda!! So it was you after all!!
Heh heh heh... But it seems you're too late!!
What on earth are you guys up to!?
You have no need to know. After all, you will all die here...
You should know it well, no? This is the very Tyrant that once defeated the five Ultra Brothers.
The best parts of the kaiju you've beaten, fused into one and reborn as the mightiest tyrant kaiju!
Behold! Behold this body! You should recognize every part of it!!
Barabas's arms, Seagorath's face, Bemstar's torso, Red King's legs, Alien Icarus's ears...
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
So it was Tyrant in that cage!
Precisely. But taming this thing was no easy task. After all, it breaks out of any cage with ease.
I see! So that's why we couldn't get near the cage!!
Yes, the "Terror Field"... It was held in check by the power of "fear."
Yes, yes, I understand. I'll let you run wild soon enough.
Fuhahahahahaha!! Its pent-up fighting instinct is about to explode!!
Heroes, are you prepared!? Tyrant!! Now's the time to avenge your years of hatred!!
Th-this can't be...!! My Tyrant!! Curse you... Then I'll finish you with my own hands!!
Very well, I'll take you on!!
Oh yeah! You wanna fight!? I'll take you on anytime!

notes.note: Rows #0.93-104 of table 0576 are not called by 0576.bla (base debrief, speakers unrecovered). Inferred: #0.98/#0.100/#0.102 an investigator who heard the enemy talk (likely Accel, first person 'ore'); #0.101 rough voice; #0.103 casual; #0.104 a leader assigning Accel and Birth. Lines kept neutral enough for any of these speakers.
'Accel and Birth too' = they accompany the team; rendered as an instruction from the leader to the two of them.
Earth's memories (hoshi no kioku) rendered as in earlier slices; 'out of it' = out of the Gaia Gate.

#0.4-18 leader block (TextIdOffset+3+k). Pt_Chara_Check order 1,4,5,3,2,6,15,7,14,9,10,12,11,8,13 gives Rider 1, W, OOO, Den-O, RX, Nu, Zero, Zeta, Mebius, Wing Zero, 00, Seven, Ultraman, God Gundam, Taro; wording fits (#0.7 'snake bastard' = Momotaros, #0.8 RX). Rider 1's harsher 'kisama' version and #0.10 plain version both kept as 'you again' lines.
'Hebi yarou' kept at full strength: 'snake bastard'.
Tyrant's roar has no precedent in the corpus; coined 'Gyiaaaaaaaaah!!' and reused in #0.62.
#0.24-28 ('...!!', 5 rows) are presumably the Ultra leaders who know Tyrant; #0.29-38 ('...!?', 10 rows) the others. Identical Japanese kept identical.
Bōkun kaijū rendered 'tyrant kaiju' (Tyrant's official classification, echoing its name).
Ikarusu seijin not in glossary: used established English 'Alien Icarus'. Source list layout flattened to one line.
#0.43 is Taro's line; #0.44-57 are unused identical copies; all rendered identically. #0.58 is empty in the table.
The Terror Field belongs to Terror Dopant, not Garagaranda, so the dropped subject of 'was holding it down' is rendered passively.
'Sekinen no urami' = Tyrant's (the defeated kaiju's) long-held grudge against the heroes.
Spoken after the Tyrant battle (GoToBattle between #0.65 and #0.67).

#0.69-83 leader block (TextIdOffset+68+k), order 4,1,13,11,12,14,15,5,3,2,6,7,8,9,10 = W, Rider 1, Taro, Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero, OOO, Den-O, RX, Nu, Zeta, God Gundam, Wing Zero, 00. Matches wording (#0.75 Zero, #0.77 Momotaros). The '00' speaker label on #0.69/#0.70 is the portrait slot, not the actual speaker.

report: 80/80 rows translated. Uncertain: 0576 #0.100-104 speakers unrecovered (base debrief, not called by the dungeon script); leader blocks #0.4-18 and #0.69-83 voiced by Pt_Chara_Check order + wording; Tyrant roar coined; #0.61 Terror Field subject made passive. Not in glossary: Alien Icarus, 'Terror Field', 'tyrant kaiju', 'Gaia Impact' (prior slice).
